title: E2E integration tests: login, chat, approvals, pipeline, logout

Both local and remote paths.

Remote mode E2E: gocloak login → WG tunnel → chat → approve → disconnect passes
Pipeline E2E: pick spec → breakdown → execute → monitor passes
Session management E2E: create → rename → resume → delete passes
Model switching E2E: pin → cycle → switch passes
